headline: Kotyark Industries cancels scheduled board meeting
hook: Board meeting called off for Kotyark
summary: Kotyark Industries has informed the stock exchange that its board meeting scheduled for Monday, October 12, 2026, has been cancelled. No reasons were provided in the filing for the cancellation of this meeting. Retail investors holding shares in the company should check for subsequent disclosures regarding a rescheduled date. Procedural delays like this rarely impact core business fundamentals.
whats_next: Announcement of a rescheduled board meeting date
why_it_matters: Meeting cancellation delays corporate updates for shareholders.

headline: Kotyark Industries board scheduled to meet on October 12 for preferential issue and ESOPs
hook: Capital raise and employee stock plans ahead
summary: Kotyark Industries has announced that its board of directors will convene on October 12. The meeting agenda includes considering a preferential issue of shares and employee stock option plans (ESOPs). Such corporate actions can impact share dilution and equity compensation structures for existing shareholders. Retail investors should monitor the outcome of the board meeting for details on pricing and equity expansion.
why_it_matters: Potential share dilution for existing holders from new issue.
